name: colon-any
description: The `: any` type ANNOTATION is the uncounted sibling of the ratcheted `as any` cast (audit F-06-1). `: any` on a tenant key (organizationId), a money value, an auth field, or external input erases the type checker exactly as `as any` does — the leads.organizationId-widening class the as-any ratchet exists to stop, walking straight past it because that ratchet only matches the `as any` cast form. This freezes the annotation count over server/ and drives it DOWN. Remediate the tenant-key/money/auth subset first; lower baselineCount as annotations are typed away. New `: any` now fails CI.
lastBumpNote: 2972 -> 2950 on 2026-08-15: unit 116 deleted fifteen module orphans (~4,100 LOC) under the founder's 'Delete all 15' ruling — the 22 annotations lived in the deleted files. Not a typing improvement, a deletion: the cheapest way to satisfy any of these gates. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 2975 -> 2972 on 2026-08-15: the three mounted /developer/* endpoints in routes-epic-services.ts were REMOVED (founder ruling, picker). Not a typing improvement — a deletion, which is the cheapest way to satisfy any of these gates. The removed handlers carried `catch (err: any)` and an `as any` on the organizationIntegrations insert; that last one is worth naming, because it erased the fact that the row's `credentials` blob had no declared shape — which is how a key hash could be written under provider='api_key' while the ONLY verifier in the repo (mcp-server.ts) matches provider='mcp_api_key'. An untyped blob is exactly where a write with no reader goes unnoticed, and here the response still told the customer 'store this key securely'. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule. PRIOR NOTE — 2992 -> 2990 on 2026-08-13: POST /api/notes/:id/record-payment, deleted (BLOCKERS B10, founder ruling that acquired_notes/note_payments is the successor to notes/payments). The first is where the erasure mattered: `updateData` accumulated currentBalance, nextPaymentDate, status and autoPayEnabled and was passed straight into `.set()`, so nothing checked that a MONEY column was receiving a String(float) — which is what the route computed, against a house rule (shared/finance/cents.ts) requiring integer cents. The route had no caller: the record-payment modal posts to /api/notes/:id/payments, the transactional cents-family route. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule.
